hero.subtitle: Get to know our essence at the root.
hero.description: Always innovating and looking to the future, Flying Studio has reinvented itself with each new challenge, always seeking new horizons.

historia.title: History
historia.description: We strive to be your ideal partner, leveraging your launch through 3D technology. With more than a decade of history, we have actively participated in the trajectory and success of our partners, not only producing images and films, but also building a great legacy. We stand out for our enthusiasm, hands-on profile, and market vision.
historia.description2: Throughout this journey, while illustrating tomorrow for the market's biggest players, we absorbed the intelligence behind every success. We followed the birth of hundreds of developments and learned to read the market's whispers — what draws the investor's eye, what accelerates a launch, and what turns a plot of land into an object of desire. Art will always be our compass, but it was this experience that gave us market precision.
historia.imageAlt1: Flying Studio team at the office
historia.imageAlt3: 'An image is worth a thousand words' mural at the office

cultura.title: Culture
cultura.description: We believe in creativity, collaboration, and authenticity, valuing every member of our team and their ideas. Our culture of continuous evolution encourages learning to achieve success. Be genuine, be innovative, and join us on this journey into the future!

proposito.title: Purpose
proposito.description: We use art and 3D technology as tools to anticipate the future, weaving dreams and delivering experiences that raise the real estate market to a new level of beauty and innovation. We value every detail in creating unique, captivating spaces, understanding our clients' needs and turning ideas into masterpieces.

manifesto.title: Manifesto
manifesto.description: We were born to give shape to the invisible. Since May 9, 2011, we have virtually materialized the buyer's dream before the first brick was laid, making clients experience the future. Far beyond perspectives — that has always been our motto and, secretly, our prophecy.

missao.title: Mission
missao.description: To transform how the real estate market presents itself, delivering unique and engaging visual experiences through cutting-edge technology and 3D images that move people.

visao.title: Vision
visao.description: To be recognized as a reference in technological and visual solutions for the national and international real estate market, generating positive impact through inspiring, memorable creations.

valores.title: Values
valores.description: Innovation, quality, integrity, collaboration, passion, and responsibility are our watchwords. We are always in pursuit of creative, surprising solutions for our clients without ever giving up excellent service.

statement.headline: We don't just display tomorrow — we make it felt.
statement.complement: If one image speaks louder than a thousand words, imagine the power of an entire digital universe conspiring in favor of your next big sale.

qg.title: The epicenter of real estate technology
qg.address: Av. Engenheiro Luís Carlos Berrini, 936 — 7th floor, São Paulo
qg.description: More than a studio: an innovation lab where creative minds, technology developers, and launch strategists work in full synergy. Wherever your development is being born, it is from here that we orchestrate the visual and technological intelligence that will make it dominate the market.

vozes.title: Those who live Flying, tell it
vozes.description: Five questions, dozens of real stories. Scroll the line and dive into what turns a job into belonging.
vozes.closing: It's never too early and never too late to start. That's the line connecting every story here — and it's still being written.

transformacao.question: What would your past self be most surprised to learn about who you are today?
transformacao.quote: You took too long to accept this challenge.

pertencimento.question: What makes Flying different from anywhere else you've worked?
pertencimento.quote: There is no ceiling for growth here. It's brotherhood.

pluralidade.question: In practice, what does 'never too early, never too late to start' mean?
pluralidade.quote: From Pablo's 15 years to Enrique's 48 — the same hunger to learn.

impacto.question: How does it feel to see a project of yours materialized on the street?
impacto.quote: 'My husband made that' — the 3D that becomes a family's dream.

proposito.question: Why is the overflow of knowledge Flying's main pillar?
proposito.quote: The company is just a formality for people to connect.
